title: fix: redact credentials from request log context
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Redacts credential query parameters before adding the public URL to shared request-log context.
- Keeps non-sensitive query parameters and the shared Gen/Enter logger unchanged.
- Covers local, test, staging, and production logging; 9 focused tests and both service typechecks pass.

gist.headline: The logs learned discretion
gist.blurb: Polli put a tiny privacy curtain over sensitive URL details before they reach the shared logbook. The useful bits still make it through; the secrets get to stay secret.
gist.summary: Shared request logging now removes credential query parameters from public URLs while preserving non-sensitive parameters across local, test, staging, and production environments.
gist.impact: Developers retain useful request context in the Gen and Enter logs with sensitive URL details kept out of shared log entries.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful librarian or log keeper at a cozy terminal, placing a small privacy curtain over a sealed secret note before filing a request-log scroll; harmless query-symbol flowers remain visible. The scene represents preserving useful diagnostics while protecting sensitive details.
